P088.authors: Liu Pan; Lei Xu; Bin Yan

complete_examples.text: The model leverages the distinct vibration characteristics of the near- and far- field regions of TTTS system, employing different modelling approaches: the FEM, known for its superior shape adaptability and precise high-frequency dynamic response computation, is applied to the tunnel and near-field soil; the SEM, recognized for its rapid convergence and suitability for low-frequency dynamic response, is utilized for the far-field soil.
